主要内容: Ms. McKenna-Doyle resigned from the board of directors of INSPERITY, INC. effective August 24, 2017, to focus on other professional commitments. Her resignation is not due to any disagreements with the company on operational, policy, or practice matters. She had served on the board since 2015 and held roles on the Nominating and Corporate Governance Committee, as well as the Finance, Risk Management and Audit Committee.
